setup.route.title: Download source
setup.route.autoDetail: Try the international source first, then the mainland China mirror if unavailable.
setup.title: Vulcan Code Setup
setup.hint.choose: ↑↓ Choose · Enter Continue · Esc Back · Q Quit
setup.hint.toggle: ↑↓ Move · Space Toggle · Enter Continue · Esc Back · Q Quit
setup.hint.input: Type a path · Enter Continue · Esc Back · Ctrl+C Quit
setup.hint.ports: Type a range · Enter Continue · Esc Back · Ctrl+C Quit
setup.hint.summary: Enter Continue · Esc Back · Q Quit
setup.components.title: Optional components
setup.components.guiDetail: The graphical app with its tray icon; on Linux it needs a desktop environment
setup.components.browserDetail: Chromium for the browser tools; a large download
setup.location.title: Installation directory
setup.location.detail: Keep the default or type another directory for this user.
setup.integration.title: Integration
setup.integration.menuDetail: Start the desktop app from the Start menu or the application menu
setup.integration.desktopShortcutDetail: An icon on the desktop that starts the desktop app
setup.integration.serviceDetail: Runs the Core service in the background as your own user; no administrator rights needed
setup.integration.lingerDetail: Lets the service run without a login session (loginctl enable-linger); may need sudo
setup.channel.title: Release channel
setup.channel.previewDetail: Early versions with the newest changes
setup.advanced.title: Advanced settings
setup.advanced.portsDetail: First and last port, such as 18000-18029. Leave it empty to keep the current setting, or type default for the built-in range.
setup.summary.title: Ready to install
setup.summary.root: You are installing as root: the service and the agents it runs will have root privileges.
setup.summary.detail: Next, the newest version is looked up and exactly how much will be downloaded is shown before anything changes.
setup.writes.uninstallEntry: An entry in Settings > Apps for uninstalling
setup.writes.serviceLaunchAgent: A login item for your user (launchd agent)
setup.writes.serviceLoginRun: A startup entry for your user at sign-in
setup.writes.linger: Lingering for your user, so the service keeps running after logout
setup.writes.appArmorProfile: The AppArmor profile {path}, so the desktop app starts from the dock and the app menu (asks for your administrator password)
setup.privileged.installAppArmor: This system lets only programs with an AppArmor profile use the sandbox the desktop app needs. Installing its profile needs administrator rights once; sudo may ask for your password.
setup.privileged.removeAppArmor: Removing the desktop app's AppArmor profile needs administrator rights; sudo may ask for your password.
setup.hint.review: Enter Continue · Esc Back · Q Quit
setup.hint.busy: This step cannot be interrupted; please wait
setup.working.overline: Keep this window open until the setup program finishes.
setup.working.title: Getting ready
setup.stage.preparing: Checking which files are already here
setup.review.refresh: Vulcan Code {version} is up to date
setup.review.downloadNone: Nothing; every file is already here
setup.review.detail: This is exactly what will be downloaded: files already on this computer are reused.
setup.review.refreshDetail: Nothing is downloaded; the commands, shortcuts and service are set up again.
setup.done.updated: Vulcan Code is updated from {from} to {version}
setup.done.startMenu: Desktop app: Start menu > Vulcan Code
setup.done.appMenu: Desktop app: Vulcan Code in the application menu
setup.done.shortcut: Desktop app: the Vulcan Code icon on the desktop
setup.done.bundle: Desktop app: search "Vulcan Code" in Spotlight, or open {path}
setup.done.modify: {command} — change components, shortcuts or the channel
setup.done.uninstall: {command} uninstall — remove Vulcan Code; sessions and settings are kept unless you add --purge
setup.done.uninstallWindows: Settings > Apps > Vulcan Code also removes it.
setup.done.selfUpdate: The setup program updates itself first whenever it installs or updates.
setup.done.browserDependencies: The built-in browser needs system libraries once: {command} (uses sudo)
setup.failed.title: The installation did not finish
setup.failed.detail: Run the setup program again to try once more; files already downloaded are kept.
